recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and service driven by burnout or lack of training
recommendations.action: Implement a mandatory customer service training program and review staff scheduling to reduce fatigue and burnout.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved customer interactions, higher staff morale, and a reduction in negative attitude complaints.

recommendations.issue: Slow wait times and bottlenecks during peak hours
recommendations.action: Redistribute front-of-house and kitchen responsibilities, and introduce a streamlined order-routing system to eliminate peak-hour bottlenecks.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster table turnover, reduced customer wait times, and improved overall dining flow.

recommendations.action: Establish standardized recipe cards, conduct daily quality-control checks before service, and audit ingredient suppliers.
recommendations.expected_impact: Consistent dish preparation, guaranteed ingredient freshness, and a drop in food-related complaints.
